I am a data professional with a strong foundation in **Economics and Statistics**, focused on developing practical expertise in **Data Analytics and Data Science**.

My approach to data is rooted in statistical thinking and business problem solving. I believe that data without a narrative is just numbers. I specialize in turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights through data analysis, data visualization, and data storytelling.

Using tools like Python, SQL, and Machine Learning, I build scalable data-driven solutions and continuously expand my skill set to stay at the forefront of the industry.
